about: Ask CAAIL's fixed question set: questions with a known answer in the corpus, each with the entries a correct answer must cite. mustCite is a list of groups; an answer is right when it cites at least one entry of every group. src/question-set.ts reads it, src/question-set.test.ts checks every id against the corpus built from site/public/api/, and scripts/score-questions.ts scores answers to it.
